sourceProvenance.title: Atirei o Pau no Gato
sourceProvenance.edition: Traditional Brazilian melody independently notated in C major; pitch order and rhythmic contour cross-checked against the UFSCar score marked Melodia tradicional do Brasil, a reviewed Cifra Club tablature, and a Brazilian folklore MIDI reference; Pianify editorial left-hand harmony v1
sourceProvenance.license: Public Domain (traditional Brazilian musical work); third-party reference files and arrangements are not redistributed
normalization: The first sounding note is normalized to 0 seconds.
Exact simultaneous duplicate pitches are reduced to one note.
Repeated pitches are separated by a 20 ms release gap when the source sustain overlaps the next attack.
No pitch is transposed and no source note is removed to fit the visual keyboard.

sourceReference.redistribution: not bundled; the contemporary arrangement is retained only as an external research reference
